ImageDescription.value: Dr. Jill Biden, along with Jennifer Aniston, Kristin Hahn, and Secretary of Health and Human Services Kathleen Sebelius, listens to Dr. Constanza Cocilovo during a tour of the Inova Breast Care Center in Alexandria, Va., Oct. 3, 2011.
